en.shortDescription: Open source Firebase alternative with Postgres
en.longDescription:
Supabase stack with PostgreSQL, PostgREST, GoTrue Auth, Postgres Meta, and Studio dashboard.

Studio on SERVICE_PORT_SUPABASE (3000). Requires SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_PGMETA for postgres-meta encryption, plus JWT and API keys.
